sources.title: Loading models · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Call from_pretrained () to download and load a model's weights and configuration stored on the Hugging Face Hub. The from_pretrained () method loads weights stored in the safetensors file format if they're available. Traditionally, PyTorch model weights are serialized with the pickle utility which is known to be unsecure.
